name: WDesignKit – AI Website Builder for WordPress with MCP & AI Widget Builder
author: POSIMYTH

sections.description:
WDesignKit gives you 3000+ Elementor templates, Gutenberg templates and template kits, 220+ ready-made Elementor widgets, Gutenberg blocks and Bricks elements, and a free widget builder for Elementor, Gutenberg and Bricks, all from one template library inside WordPress.

Want AI to do the work? Connect your AI assistant through the WordPress MCP (Model Context Protocol) and describe what you need in plain language: a full website from an AI template kit, a custom Elementor, Gutenberg or Bricks widget, or a WordPress code snippet. WDesignKit builds it inside your site, using your page builder.

Works with the AI tools you already use, including Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf and Visual Studio Code.

VISIT WDESIGNKIT WEBSITE

Quick Navigation Links

Website | Docs | Pricing | Video Tutorials

Elementor Templates, Gutenberg Templates & Template Kits

Browse the full template library (landing pages, full website kits, headers, footers and sections) and import any Elementor template or Gutenberg template in one click. Every AI workflow below draws on the same library:

  • 1600+ Elementor Templates, Kits & Sections and 1500+ Gutenberg Templates & Patterns.
  • 220+ ready-made widgets: 110+ Elementor widgets, 30+ Gutenberg blocks and 80+ Bricks elements.
  • Widget Builder: Turn your own HTML, CSS and JS into Elementor, Gutenberg, Nexter or Bricks widgets, and convert between builders with the 1-Click Widget Converter.
  • Cloud Workspace and 60+ Figma Website Kits: Store and share templates, widgets and designs with your team.

AI Website Builder With AI Templates

  • AI Templates: Describe your site and import the template kit that fits, pre-filled with AI-written content for your business. No more replacing placeholder text line by line. Your AI assistant can also search the template library and import pages and sections for you.

AI Widget Builder For Elementor, Gutenberg & Bricks

  • AI Widget Builder: Describe a widget, such as a SaaS hero, logo cloud, testimonial carousel, stats counter or FAQ accordion, and your AI tool builds it as a production-ready widget.

  • Elementor Widgets with AI: Generate full Elementor widgets with editable controls, or convert existing ones.

  • Gutenberg: Build core blocks and Nexter blocks from a single prompt.
  • Bricks: Create custom Bricks elements without leaving your AI assistant.

AI Code Generator For WordPress Snippets

  • AI Code Snippets: Generate custom WordPress code snippets through a conversation with your AI tool. No manual coding or copy-pasting into functions.php.

WordPress MCP Workflow For Your AI Assistant

  • MCP Workflow connects your AI assistant to WDesignKit through the WordPress MCP (Model Context Protocol). Instead of clicking through dashboards, you ask in chat and the assistant runs the task on your site.

Setup takes a few minutes: install the plugin, connect WDesignKit, enable permissions, and add the MCP configuration to your AI assistant, such as Claude (Claude MCP for WordPress) or Cursor.

🔍 OUR PRODUCTS

💰 The Plus Addons for Elementor – 120+ Elementor widgets.

💰 NexterWP Theme, Blocks & Extensions – Starter theme, 90+ Gutenberg blocks and 22+ extensions.

💰 UiChemy – Convert Figma designs into Elementor and Bricks websites.

External services

  1. wdesignkit.com API : This API is used to fetch plugin-related data for onboarding and updates. It sends the plugin version and identifier during activation, updates, or specific plugin-related requests. For more details, you can review the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
  2. api.wordpress.org : This API retrieves plugin metadata and compatibility information from WordPress.org. It sends the plugin identifier during updates or when checking compatibility. More information can be found in the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
  3. api.posimyth.com : Usage analytics. Off by default; submitting the deactivation feedback form also sends it, plus your admin email if you tick the contact box. Terms · Privacy
  4. AI Templates : This feature sends your prompt to WDesignKit’s AI service to generate ready-to-use template content. No content is sent unless you actively use this feature. For more details, review the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
  5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) : The AI Widget Builder, AI Code Snippets, and MCP Workflow features connect WDesignKit to a third-party AI tool of your choice (such as Claude) over the Model Context Protocol. Your prompts, and where applicable your existing widget/template code, are sent to that AI tool to generate the result. This only happens when you actively connect and use an AI tool via MCP; review the privacy policy and terms of the AI tool you connect, in addition to WDesignKit’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New and search for “WDesignKit”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open WDesignKit from the admin menu and follow the MCP Workflow setup to connect your AI assistant.
sections.faq:
What is WordPress MCP and why does WDesignKit use it?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard that lets AI assistants use tools on other systems. WDesignKit exposes its templates, widget builder, code snippets and workspaces as MCP abilities, so an assistant such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor can build and manage them on your WordPress site from a chat.

Which AI tools work with WDesignKit?

Any AI tool that supports MCP, including Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf and Visual Studio Code.

Can I use WDesignKit without AI?

Yes. You can import templates, use the ready-made widgets and build widgets from your own code by hand, without connecting an AI tool.

Does it Work with Any WordPress Theme?

Yes this works with all the Themes, but it works best in sync with our Nexter WordPress Theme.

Is Widget Builder free to use?

Yes. Our Elementor Widget Builder, Gutenberg Blocks Builder & Bricks Elements Builder are 100% free to use. There are some limitations on the number of widgets you can create in the free plan. Building widgets or code snippets with AI requires a connected AI tool via MCP; it is not available as a standalone feature inside the plugin.

Can I save templates from both Elementor Free and Pro using WDesignKit?

Yes, You can save and use Elementor Free and Pro both templates.

What page builders are currently supported with WDesignKit?

Currently, for Templates, we have support for Elementor and Gutenberg only. For Widget Builder & ready-made widgets, we support Elementor, Gutenberg, and Bricks. Templates for Bricks are not available yet.

Do i Need any Elementor Addon to use the Plugin?

WDesignKit does not have any direct dependency on any Elementor Addon, but some Elementor Templates & Gutenberg Blocks require The Plus Addons for Elementor or Nexter Blocks for full import of website.

Does WDesignKit share any data about my site?

Only if you turn it on. Usage analytics are off by default; a few days after installing, WDesignKit asks once whether you want to share non-sensitive usage details, and nothing is sent unless you opt in. You can turn it on or off any time from WDesignKit > Settings. No personal data, no license key and no page content is ever sent.

How can I report security bugs?

You can report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team helps validate, triage and handle any security vulnerabilities. Report a security vulnerability.

I run Nginx. Do I need to block direct access to the Widget Builder files?

Widgets you build are written as PHP and JSON files under wp-content/uploads/wdesignkit/. The JSON holds the widget’s source, including any custom PHP. WDesignKit writes an .htaccess there that denies direct HTTP access to .php and .json files, but Nginx does not read .htaccess, so on Nginx that file has no effect.

Add this to your server block and reload Nginx:

location ~* /wp-content/uploads/wdesignkit/.*\.(php|json)$ { deny all; }

Place it before any generic PHP location block so it takes precedence. This does not affect the widgets themselves: WordPress loads them from disk, not over HTTP.

Is the widget PHP editor sandboxed? Is it safe to give any user?

No. The widget PHP editor executes PHP with the site’s normal WordPress and PHP privileges — the same as code in a theme’s functions.php or a plugin. It is intended only for trusted administrators.

WDesignKit scans submitted PHP and blocks common dangerous constructs (shell execution, eval, filesystem writes, and similar). Treat that scan as a guard-rail against accidental or opportunistic mistakes, not as a sandbox or a security boundary: it does not and cannot prevent a determined administrator from writing harmful PHP, because authored code runs with full privileges by design.

Access is restricted to administrators with the manage_options capability; on multisite, to network administrators only; and the feature is disabled by default on any site that sets DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT. A site owner can turn it off entirely with the wdkit_can_edit_php filter, or re-enable it under DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT with the wdkit_allow_php_when_file_edit_disabled filter.

short_description: 3000+ Elementor & Gutenberg templates, 220+ widgets and an AI widget builder for Elementor, Gutenberg & Bricks. Build from Claude or Cursor via MCP.
description:
WDesignKit gives you 3000+ Elementor templates, Gutenberg templates and template kits, 220+ ready-made Elementor widgets, Gutenberg blocks and Bricks elements, and a free widget builder for Elementor, Gutenberg and Bricks, all from one template library inside WordPress.

Want AI to do the work? Connect your AI assistant through the WordPress MCP (Model Context Protocol) and describe what you need in plain language: a full website from an AI template kit, a custom Elementor, Gutenberg or Bricks widget, or a WordPress code snippet. WDesignKit builds it inside your site, using your page builder.

Works with the AI tools you already use, including Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf and Visual Studio Code.

VISIT WDESIGNKIT WEBSITE

Quick Navigation Links

Website | Docs | Pricing | Video Tutorials

Elementor Templates, Gutenberg Templates & Template Kits

Browse the full template library (landing pages, full website kits, headers, footers and sections) and import any Elementor template or Gutenberg template in one click. Every AI workflow below draws on the same library:

  • 1600+ Elementor Templates, Kits & Sections and 1500+ Gutenberg Templates & Patterns.
  • 220+ ready-made widgets: 110+ Elementor widgets, 30+ Gutenberg blocks and 80+ Bricks elements.
  • Widget Builder: Turn your own HTML, CSS and JS into Elementor, Gutenberg, Nexter or Bricks widgets, and convert between builders with the 1-Click Widget Converter.
  • Cloud Workspace and 60+ Figma Website Kits: Store and share templates, widgets and designs with your team.

AI Website Builder With AI Templates

  • AI Templates: Describe your site and import the template kit that fits, pre-filled with AI-written content for your business. No more replacing placeholder text line by line. Your AI assistant can also search the template library and import pages and sections for you.

AI Widget Builder For Elementor, Gutenberg & Bricks

  • AI Widget Builder: Describe a widget, such as a SaaS hero, logo cloud, testimonial carousel, stats counter or FAQ accordion, and your AI tool builds it as a production-ready widget.

  • Elementor Widgets with AI: Generate full Elementor widgets with editable controls, or convert existing ones.

  • Gutenberg: Build core blocks and Nexter blocks from a single prompt.
  • Bricks: Create custom Bricks elements without leaving your AI assistant.

AI Code Generator For WordPress Snippets

  • AI Code Snippets: Generate custom WordPress code snippets through a conversation with your AI tool. No manual coding or copy-pasting into functions.php.

WordPress MCP Workflow For Your AI Assistant

  • MCP Workflow connects your AI assistant to WDesignKit through the WordPress MCP (Model Context Protocol). Instead of clicking through dashboards, you ask in chat and the assistant runs the task on your site.

Setup takes a few minutes: install the plugin, connect WDesignKit, enable permissions, and add the MCP configuration to your AI assistant, such as Claude (Claude MCP for WordPress) or Cursor.

🔍 OUR PRODUCTS

💰 The Plus Addons for Elementor – 120+ Elementor widgets.

💰 NexterWP Theme, Blocks & Extensions – Starter theme, 90+ Gutenberg blocks and 22+ extensions.

💰 UiChemy – Convert Figma designs into Elementor and Bricks websites.

External services

  1. wdesignkit.com API : This API is used to fetch plugin-related data for onboarding and updates. It sends the plugin version and identifier during activation, updates, or specific plugin-related requests. For more details, you can review the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
  2. api.wordpress.org : This API retrieves plugin metadata and compatibility information from WordPress.org. It sends the plugin identifier during updates or when checking compatibility. More information can be found in the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
  3. api.posimyth.com : Usage analytics. Off by default; submitting the deactivation feedback form also sends it, plus your admin email if you tick the contact box. Terms · Privacy
  4. AI Templates : This feature sends your prompt to WDesignKit’s AI service to generate ready-to-use template content. No content is sent unless you actively use this feature. For more details, review the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
  5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) : The AI Widget Builder, AI Code Snippets, and MCP Workflow features connect WDesignKit to a third-party AI tool of your choice (such as Claude) over the Model Context Protocol. Your prompts, and where applicable your existing widget/template code, are sent to that AI tool to generate the result. This only happens when you actively connect and use an AI tool via MCP; review the privacy policy and terms of the AI tool you connect, in addition to WDesignKit’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
